cohort: The participants were 18 cases of nonimmune hydrops fetalis (NIHF) with negative chromosomal microarray analysis who underwent thoracoamniotic shunt and had continuing pregnancy.
finding: Single-gene disorders were a major cause of perinatal death in NIHF cases undergoing fetal therapy, and prenatal rapid exome sequencing has the potential to improve neonatal survival after TAS by guiding fetal therapy.
followup_time: Neonatal (implicitly up to 28 days post-birth, but no specific duration stated)
gest_age: Median gestational ages at intervention and delivery were 31.2 weeks (22.0-33.1) and 34.3 weeks (29.7-38.6), respectively.
